preconditions.description: The number of numbers n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each number a_i in the list a is between 0 and 9 inclusive.
The length of the string s is between 1 and 3 inclusive.
The string s contains only the characters '-', '+', and '*'.
All characters in the string s are distinct.

postconditions.description: The output consists of n numbers separated by n - 1 symbols.

postconditions.expression: all(x in s for x in stdout if x in {'-', '+', '*'})
postconditions.description: All symbols in the output are from the allowed set s.

postconditions.expression: all(x.isdigit() for x in stdout.split() if x.isdigit())
postconditions.description: All numbers in the output are digits from the input list a.
The evaluated value of the output expression is the maximum possible value.
